about: Templates for the H2S and VOC FACTORY sheets. When a sheet arrives, fill every null from it and add the record to calibration_records.json with a valid_from LATER than the datasheet record, so it takes over from the datasheet typical values. Do not use any value that is not on the factory sheet.

records.notes: From the ISB factory sheet: WE total zero (mV), AE total zero (mV), sensitivity (mV/ppb).
From the PID factory sheet: zero (mV) goes in we_zero_mv; sensitivity (mV/ppm).
